page.content:
Sonic the Hedgehog is a licensed theme based on the video game series by SEGA. It was first introduced in 2016 as a sub-theme of LEGO Dimensions, before becoming its own theme in 2023.

page.overview:
What is Sonic the Hedgehog?

Sonic the Hedgehog is a licensed theme based on the video game series by SEGA. It was first introduced in 2016 as a sub-theme of LEGO Dimensions, before becoming its own theme in 2023.
